4a1(1): //sum cu drug gi rgyal ba rnams kyang mthong //bskald pa sum cu drug tu thams cad mkhyend pa bsnyen bkur spyad pa spyod //da dung tshul mkhas 'di dag bskald pa grangs myed sum cu rtsa drug du //gang
4a2(1): zag chen po 'di dag rgyal ba khyu mchog mchod pa byed cing gnas //thams cad du yang phun sum tshul rtog rgyal ba'i mchog la mchod pa byed //rkang gnyis gtso bo mchod de byang chub zhi ba yongs su btsal byas nas //
4a3(1): de dag de'i 'og tu dpal stug rkang gnyis dam pa skyes bu mchog //'drend pa mthu chen yon tan ldan bar gser gyi rgyal mtshan bskal la 'byung //rgyal ba de dag sna tshogs zhing na gnas shing rang rang zhing sbyangs te //
4a4(1): sems can dam pa de kun nyi ma'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dpal zhes bya //de tshe yon tan ldan ba de dag rnams kyi 'dus pa grangs myed de //de tshe thub pa re re'i nyan thos 'dus par 'gyur ba de dag ni //
4a5(1): gal te bskald pa khrag khrig dag tu stobs bcus nyan thos de ba grangs kyang //legs mdzad rnams kyi nyan thos 'dus pa dag ni mthar phyind bgrangs myi 'gyur //'dus pa de dag thams
4a6(1): cad grangs myed 'dus pa de ni ci 'dra ba //de las gnyis 'gyur de tshe byang chub du ni yang dag zhugs par 'gyur //de tshe rgyal bar zhugs kyi rgyal ba thams cad mkhyend pa nyid ma yin //de dag
4a7(1): thams cad yongs dag zhing du spyad nas kun kyang rgyal bar 'gyur //bde gshegs de dag spyod pa gang yin de dag rnams kyi 'ang de nyid 'gyur //'jig rten mkhas pa de dag mya ngan 'das par gyurd nas dam pa'i chos //
4a8(1): de tshe sras kyis bzung zhing bskald pa bye ba brgyad cur gnas par gyurd //de dag 'das nas stond pa'i gsung rab de la byang chub sems bskyed pa //gang ga'i klung gi bye ma bas kyang shind tu mang ba 'byung bar 'gyur //de
4a9(1): dag 'das nas stond pa skyob pa rnams kyi gsung rab de la ni //nyan thos rgya mtsho kun kyi bye snyed dpag yas mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur //de ltar 'jig rten don rnams mdzad pa rang 'byung de dag thams cad kyi //bstand pa gang
4a10(1): yin de ni chos dang yongs su legs par ldan gyurd cing //yang dag bshad par gyurd te de ni bstand pa rnams kyi chos nyid yin //myi mchog de'i gsung rab de thos 'gro ba ma lus dad gyurd nas //rkang gnyis dam pa gzhal

4b2(1): lta bas na dga' bar byos la mgo la 'bar bzhin spyad spyod de //rtag tu shes rab pha rold phyind dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten byos la //yang dag mthong ba'i spyad pa dge ba 'di la kund tu bsten byos te //dge
4b3(1): slong khyed cag rkang gnyis gtso bo 'jig rten thugs brtser 'gyur bar gyis ////'bras bu che ba lung bstand pa'i le'u ste /nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o //
4b4(1): de nas gnas gtsang ma 'i ris kyi lha rnams kyis de'i tshe sems can dang ga tu myed pa byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs par rig cing /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la the tsom myed par gyurd par rig nas tshim zhing mgu la yid rangs
4b5(1): te /rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang /yid bde ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das la tshul dang 'dra ba'i tshigs su bcad pa dag gis so so nas mngon bar bstod do //de la lha'i bu sbyin ba la mos pas gsold
4b6(1): pa //khyod kyis sdug pa'i sras rnams dang //btsun mo dang ni srog phangs btang //rgyal srid btang ba ci smos te //sbyin mthar phyin la phyag kyang 'tshal //lha'i bu tshul khrims la mos
4b7(1): pas gsold pa //khyod kyis tshul khrims rnams sbyangs pa //rnam pa kun tu snyems myi mnga' //shind tu bslabs pas mthar phyind pa //khrims mthar phyin la phyag kyang 'chal //lha'i bu bzod
4b8(1): pa la mos pas gsold pa //khyod gyis bzod pa bstend mdzad pas //yan lag gtub pa 'ang bzod par mdzad //zab mo sgyid lug ma lags te //bzod mthar phyind la phyag kyang 'tshal /lha'i bu brtson 'grus
4b9(1): la mos pas gsold pa //brtson ba ma btang brtson 'grus te //stobs cen brtson 'grus ldan gyurd pas //rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog brnyes pa //brtson mthar phyind la phyag kyang mtshal //lha'i bu bsam
4b10(1): gtan la mos pas gsold pa /khyod kyis bsam gtan bsten mdzad pa //de la 'jig rten gting myi rnyed //dus gsum mnyam ba nyid brnyes pa //bsam gtan mthar phyind phyag kyang 'tshal //lha'i bu gzi brjid
7a1(1): //dang ma 'gags pa //bar na 'ang gnas pa ma mchis pa //de dag rang bzhin khyod kyis gzigs //lha'i bu stong pa nyid la gnas pas gsold pa //gang zag sems can ma mchis pa //ma
7a2(1): mchis tha snyad ma mchis pa //bstand pa'i slad du brjod bgyi ba //de dag rang bzhin khyed kyis gzigs //lha'i bum tshan ma myed pa la gnas pas gsold pa//gang gis tha snyad gdags pa yi //mtshan ma
7a3(1): de dag ma mchis te //chos kun mtshan ma ma mchis par //rnam par 'drend pa khyod kyis gzigs //lha'i bu smon pa myed pa la gnas pas gsauld pa //ji ltar mtshan ma stong gyurd cing //smond pa dmyigs
7a4(1): su ma mchis dang //su la smon lam mchis gyurd pa //de yang de lta 'i tshul du mkhyend //lha'i bu ting nge 'dzind la gzhol bas gsold pa //rnam thard sgo la brten bgyis shing //gang zhig 'grol
7a5(1): 'gyur de ma mchis //de bzhin kun nas nyon mongs pa //de dag rang bzhin khyod kyis gzigs //lha'i bu ma smad pas gsold pa //khyod ni sdig pa kun spangs shing //bsod
7a6(1): nams thams cad bsags gyurd te //bde gshegs khyod la smod myi mnga' //su smod de dag mkhas ma lags //lha'i bu glog gi sprin kyis gsold pa //ji ltar glog bcas sprin
7a7(1): kyi tshogs //chard kyis sa chen ngoms par bgyid //de bzhin 'drend pas chos char gyis //'jig rten rnams ni ngoms par mdzad //lha'i bu bsam ba don yod kyis gsold pa //thub khyod gsung ni
7a8(1): don mchis te //chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskord //shind tu brtags te mdzad pas na //de ni thams cad mkhyend pa'i mtshan //lha'i bu blo phun sum tshogs pas gsold pa //chos rnams thams cad dngos nyid
7a9(1): kyis //ma skyes ma 'gags ma lags te //de dag bde gshegs khyod kyis mkhyend //gzhan yang de bzhin rtogs par mdzad //lha'i bu seng ge'i nga ros gsold pa //khyod kyis stong pa nyid bstand te //
7a10(1): seng ge'i nga ro bsgrags mdzad pas //mu stegs can kun rab 'jigs pa //seng ges ri dgas phra mo bzhin //lha'i bu bag yod las kyis gsold pa //bag yod sngon tu btang mdzad de //khyod kyis spyod pa
7b1(1): spyad bgyis pas //sangs rgyas chos la 'drend pa khyod //bag yod pas ni nges par 'byung //lha'i bu bag yod rab gnas kyis gsold pa //bag yod pa la rab gnas te //khyod kyi nyid kyi chos kyang sel //
7b2(1): stobs bcu gzhan yang sangs rgyas chos //bsam gyis myi khyab rab tu speld //lha'i bu bag yod skyes kyis gsold pa //bgag yod pa la brtson bas na //byang chub phyogs rnams yongs dag skyes //thub
7b3(1): cen rang yang grol gyurd nas //de dag rnams ni 'jig rten 'greld //lha'i bu bag yod/nges par byung gis gsold pa //byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos dag //ji snyed thard la rtend pa'i rnams //kun kyang
7b4(1): khyod la bslabs pa ste //bag yod par ni nges par byung //lha'i bu bag yod gnas pas gsold pa //bag yodayongs su ma btang bas //rnam par 'drend pa khyod kyi sras //'gro ba 'di la ma chags
7b5(1): par //thams cad mkhyend tu nges par byung //lha'i bub ga yod bsrungs kyis gsold pa //byang chubalam la stend mdzad cing //khyod ni bag gis bsrungs pas na //thugs
7b6(1): rje chen po mkhas pa yis //byang chub dam pa brnyes par gyurd //lha'i bu bag yod brtson gyis gsold pa //bag yod pa la rab brtson zhing //mtshan nyid gcig po rtogs bgyis bas //
7b7(1): dpa' bo chen po khyod kyi sras //yab kyi dkor yang thob par gyurd //lha'i bu ga yod mngon bar dga' bas gsold pa //bag yong dga' ba'i brtan ba rnams //de dag sangs rgyas ye shes kyis //
7b8(1): dpa' bo nyon mongs ri 'jig pas //nga rgyal ri yang de bzhin bsnyild //lha'i bu bag yod 'dzind kyis gsold pa //sangs rgyas ye shes tshol mdzad tshe //khyod ni bag gis gzung bas na //bskald pa bye ba
7b9(1): grangs myed du //khyod kyi thugs ni skyor ma gyurd //lha'i bu zhi gnas brtson gyis gsold pa //chos rnams de dag rang bzhin zhi //de ni sangs rgyas spyod yul lags //byang chub yang dag gang zhugs dang //
7b10(1): thams cad mkhyend pa der myi 'jigs //lha'i bu zhi gnas la yang dag par gnas pas gsold pa //sangs rgas zhi gnas bzhugs pa ste //'ond kyang de la chags myi mnga' //sems can nyon mongs zhi bar mdzad //
8a1(1): //rdul 'thul ba la char pa bzhin //lha'i bu zhi gnas la rab tu gnas kyis gsold pa //sangs rgyas zhi la rab tu bzhugs //sus kyang myi bskyod ri bo bzhin //khyod la gnod bgyir myi nus te //sems
8a2(1): zhi khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal //lha'i bu zhi gnas dul gyis gsold pa //khyod kyi sras rnams ma smad pa //zhi gnas kyis ni yongs su dul //bdud rnams bye bas myi tshugs te //'dod chags kyis ni gnod myi 'gyur //
8a3(1): lha'i bu zhi gnas nges par byung gis gsold pa //zhi ba'i yid mnga' zhi gnas la //dpa' bo chen po sgrom mdzad pas //ji la gnas te bsam gtan mdzad //sus kyang khyod kyi tshul ma 'tshald //lha'i bu zhi gnas
8a4(1): sngon tu 'gros gsold pa //stond pas sangs rgyas chos rnams kyi //sngon tu zhi gnas 'gro zhes gsungs //gang gis byang chub 'gru ba 'gyur ba'i //chos gzhan de'i rjes su 'brang //lha'i bu zhi 
8a5(1): gnas rjes su 'brang gis gsold pa //'jig rten sgron ma zhi gnas ni //sems kyi rtog pa dang bar bgyid //zhi ba'i sems ldan rnams kyi 'ching //de khyod mtha' yas dbang du mdzad //
8a6(1): lha'i bu zhi gnas spyod yul gyis gsold pa //chos rnams kund kyi spyod yul ni //zhi gnas yin zhes 'drend pas gsungs //de la chags myed spyod pas ni //rnam par 'drend pa sangs
8a7(1): rgyas 'gyur //lha'i bu zhi gnas brland kyis gsold pa //bsam gtan gyis ni mngon brland te //shes rab kyis ni sems bsgoms pas //de phyir rdzogs pa'i byang chub brnyes //de bzhin skye bo rnaMs
8a8(1): kyang 'drend //lha'i bu zhi gnas lhur lend kyis gsold pa //sangs rgyas chos rnams gang la yang //lam gzhan bdag gis ma mthong ste //zhi gnas ye shes che thob na //rang byung nyid du nges par 'byung //
8a9(1): lha'i bu lhag mthong mngon dgas gsold pa //dpa' bo chen po lhag mthong ni //chos rnams thams cad stond pa ste //de la khyod kyi sras spyod cing //rang byung nyid ni thob par 'gyur //lha'i bu lhag mthong byung gis
8a10(1): gsold pa //shes rab pha rold phyind gnas shing //rnam par 'drend pa' byung bar 'gyur //sman pa'i rgyal po stond pa ste //de bas lhag mthong dge ba lags //lha'i bu lhag mthong rab gnas kyis gsold pa //
8b1(1): chos rnams thams cad btsal bgyis te //yang dag ji bzhin mthong gyurd na //brtan ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'thob //byang chub nyid la gnas par 'dong //lha'i bu lhag mthong nges byung gis gsold pa //gang
8b2(1): zag mchog rnams ye shes kyis //shes rab gcig tu nges par byung //rdzogs pa'i byang chub ye shes kyis //brnyes pa'i 'drend pa skye myi 'gyur //lha'i bu lhag mthong mngon dgas gsold pa //yang dag ji bzhin
8b3(1): yang dag tu //chos rnams rnam par gzigs pas na //byang chub gzhal yas brnyes gyurd te //de bas rnam 'drend sangs rgyas lags //lha'i bu lhag mthong la mngon bar brtson bas gsold pa //mkhas pa

9a1(1): //gsold pa //dpa' bo chen po chos kun ni //lhag mthong nyid du yang dag 'du //rang bzhin myed par rnam mthong na //de ni rang byung byang chub lags //lha'i bu lhag mthong snying pos gsold pa //

9a7(1): bral zhing bcings myed la //'jigs skrag thams cad rab tu spangs //chos rnams kun la myi gnas shing //nam mkha'i rlung bzhin spyod pa mdzad //lha'i bu stonang pa nyid la mngon bar dga' bas gsold pa //

9b8(1): 'khor 'di thams cad ni //mtshan ma myed pas skom gyurd te //yab kyi dkor ni 'tshal gyurd nas //de bzhin gshegs la bkur bsti bgyid //lha'i bu mtshan ma myed pa la spyod pas gsold pa //mtshan

10a2(1): ba //de dag byang chub sgrub pa ste //yab kyi chos kyis brtul zhugs can //de dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mchod //lha'i bu mtshan ma myed la dga' bas gsold pa //gang gi mtshan ma rnam bshig pa //de dag sangs

10a10(1): grol bar 'gyur //lha'i bu smond pa myed pas byung gis gsold pa //gang gi sred par rab bcom ba //de dag mya ngan dgon pa rgald //de dag myi skom zang zing myed //dpa' chen khyod la de phyag 'tshal //lha'i

10b3(1): byung gis gsold pa //srid pa'i dgon las byung ba'i rnams //bde ba thob cing zhi gnas te //nyon mongs dgra rnams pham mdzad pa //'jig rten mgon la phyag kyang 'tshal //lha'i bu smond pa myed pas ya
